main_topics.reason: User came because infliximab stopped working and Humira was presented as the only option; most turns explore alternatives.
User is furious at being brushed off and treated as awkward, and wants to be part of the decision.
Fury and frustration open the conversation and user later says they feel they have a handle on things instead of anger.
Raised by the bot and taken up by the user as a concrete point to push back with over a few turns.
User asked directly about a second opinion and worried it would look like going behind the consultant's back.
User asked for a question list to bring to the next appointment and plans to book one.
Stated as background that the drug stopped working after four years; not explored on its own.

output.summary: User on infliximab for four years, which has stopped working, was angry that their consultant presented a switch to Humira as decided and dismissed questions about alternatives. The bot acknowledged the frustration, explained other biologic classes, suggested asking about drug levels and antibodies, gave a question list and addressed second opinions on the NHS. User ended saying they had a plan instead of a grievance and would book an appointment and take their list.
